name: Can It Be Fooled?
description: Short, punchy trick questions made for YouTube Shorts: famous riddles with one detail changed, false-premise questions mixed with true facts that sound fake, and 30-second lightning traps. Every answer is graded exactly (no judges), so it is cheap and objective. Open the run in the Presenter for the 'who got fooled' slides; add ?vertical=1 for a 1080×1920 Shorts version.
